name: @cinatra-ai/memory
description: Filesystem side of the memory subsystem for coding agents: a pure library + local CLI for OKF 0.1 bundles (Markdown + YAML frontmatter). Bundle identity (bundle.yaml), spec-strict parse/serialize/walk with structured diagnostics, deterministic index.md regeneration, atomic writes with realpath containment and caps, and a content-hash manifest that the sync layer builds its ledger on. No server-only imports, no LLM calls — everything here runs offline against the local filesystem.
